baseline: Accepted v1.3 and read-only local app ARBs, 2026-09-15
rules: Replace call sites and both locales together; do not overwrite live ARB files wholesale.
navMap is a legacy alias for mapOpen ENTRY ACTION; mapTitle remains the map heading. Only four navigation labels.
chatClosedReadOnly is shared by mutual YES and closed conversations; no duration promise. Blocked content visibility overrides read-only UI.
Canonical chatSoftTitle/Body are the only soft-contact warning strings.
requestAccept opens independent intent selection; only requestSelectAccept confirms.
Do not delete app-only keys absent from a design package.
Keep existing generated localization API and parameterized limits; do not replace live {min}/{max} APIs with hardcoded constants.
devEmulatorBanner remains debug-only; never place it in production screens.
errorAgeIneligible maps to generic profileBirthDateError; no age-threshold disclosure in rejection text.
Add v1.5 UI keys by semantic merge, preserving v1.4 aliases and current app-only keys.
Profile visibility defaults true for age, gender, occupation; saved false remains false on future loads.
endConfirm is retained: confirmation from self, never permission from the other person.

resolvedByFounder.endConfirm: Keep own-action confirmation; no approval from the other party required.

package: v1.6 / Package 2 auth correction; accepted profile unchanged

replaceFlows.v1.5 emailLinkOnly: Firebase email + password, then email verification

callsiteMoves.emailSend: Use authCreateAccount for registration submission; emailSend remains verification-email sending only.
callsiteMoves.emailChange: Not offered after account creation on waiting view; do not imply account-email mutation. Changing a pre-submit field is ordinary editing.
callsiteMoves.emailTitle: Registration heading only; login uses authSignInTitle, reset uses authResetTitle.
callsiteMoves.emailHelp: Registration explanation only; no link sign-in meaning.

prohibitedAPISemantics: email-link click alone treated as authenticated/verified
authRevision.passwordPolicy: Use the actual app/Firebase validation; no local min length, character rules, strength bar or synthetic strength vocabulary prescribed.
